extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors / users who want to create a new article
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for users attempting to create a new Wikipedia page: procedural requirements, checks to avoid duplication, and troubleshooting steps when a title does not exist or is not visible. Focused on the practical steps before creating or re-creating an article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users must have an account and meet the autoconfirmed status before they can create pages; consider creating an account and waiting until autoconfirmation conditions are met.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request a new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If not ready to create a live article, submit a draft via the article wizard or request creation so experienced editors can review and assist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing articles for alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "Hannibal Buress specials" in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a page, thoroughly search Wikipedia for variants, alternate spellings, or existing coverage to avoid duplication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use "What links here" and other link-tracking tools to find existing mentions that may indicate the topic exists under another title or as a section in another page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delay in database propagation and purge troubleshooting
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you suspect a newly created page isn't appearing, either wait for propagation or use the purge function to refresh; do not immediately recreate the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case sensitivity and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization variations and create redirects when appropriate so readers find the content under likely alternative titles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check deletion log if page was deleted
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before re-creating content, consult the deletion log and deletion reasons to understand past problems and whether recreation is appropriate or requires changes.
